verdict.rationale: Server-side recording is a fair question for a real-time communications SDK, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions server-side recording, media capture, or delivering recorded files to a customer-owned storage bucket. The cited items cover meetings, messaging, codecs, PSTN and SIP only.

support.subject: As a developer, I can record a session server-side and receive the files in my own storage bucket
